financials.key_metric: Closed-loop network. Premium consumer and SME focus.

overall_strategy_summary: American Express is a premium-focused payments company with a closed-loop network model. Digital asset strategy is cautious and exploratory (Amex Passport NFTs, CEO stablecoin commentary, Coinbase co-branded card). Core strategy focuses on premium card member acquisition (Gen Z/Millennial cohort growth), travel and lifestyle experiences, merchant partnerships, and SME services. Technology focuses on fraud prevention, personalisation, and member experience rather than blockchain infrastructure.
